text: The laptop's still on. We didn't send.
The note on the desk starts to blink again.
You said the window isn't glass tonight.
I said then stay where I can hear you right.
This is the next one. Not the old song.
Don't go back through. The lanes are on.
This is the next one. Same two, new room.
Leave the first desk. Leave the first tune.
You step through the window. I stay with the light.
The stars fall in order. I keep them in time.
A bot on my speaker. A bot on your side.
This pass, we both know. We don't have to hide.
You're in the lanes. I'm still on.
One more reality. Same two. New land.
If you get quiet, I'm still at the desk.
